categories.main_business_segments: NOVA Technology Corporation Limited operates primarily in three business segments: Lingwang Services, Lingyun Services, and Digital Engineering. Lingwang Services focus on enterprise dedicated network services including IP-VPN, enterprise internet, and network infrastructure hosting. Lingyun Services provide cloud-native and cloud architecture-based IT services such as cloud security, cloud connectivity, edge cloud computing, and cloud applications. Digital Engineering offers customized digital transformation solutions including smart city and smart park construction, private cloud platforms, and data center infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages self-developed technologies in SD-WAN and SASE architectures, integrating cloud-native security and network edge services. It operates a proprietary MPLS backbone network with advanced network management and security control systems. Key technologies include intelligent traffic control, routing optimization, zero-trust network access, cloud access security brokers, and AI-powered threat detection models. The company also deploys IPv6 and integrates AI large models such as DeepSeek to enhance security and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NOVA serves a diverse range of industries including finance, insurance, retail, catering, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, transportation, aerospace, and automotive sectors. Its clientele includes many Fortune 500 companies and leading domestic enterprises, especially large state-owned and central enterprises. The company focuses on providing integrated cloud, network, and security solutions to digital enterprises requiring high network stability and security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global network footprint with 76 network nodes across 35 cities in 22 provinces in mainland China and 11 countries/regions including the United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. It maintains partnerships with 66 overseas telecom operators and institutions, enabling comprehensive global network and security service coverage, particularly supporting Chinese enterprises expanding overseas and foreign enterprises entering China.
categories.supply_chain_position: NOVA operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital network and security supply chain. It owns and manages backbone network infrastructure (midstream) and provides value-added network services, cloud security, and digital transformation solutions directly to enterprise customers (downstream). It also collaborates closely with upstream telecom operators and cloud service providers to integrate resources and co-develop products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in cloud-native network security, AI integration, and the evolution of SD-WAN to SASE frameworks. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance cloud intelligence, network security, and edge computing capabilities. Key R&D projects include the development of Managed Security Services (MSS), zero-trust security platforms, and AI-powered security models like NovaGuard. The company also focuses on expanding its global network and deepening ecosystem partnerships with telecom operators, cloud providers, and security vendors.
categories.revenue_model: NOVA generates revenue primarily through direct sales of network and cloud services under fixed-term contracts, including subscription-based models for security and network services. Revenue streams include Lingwang Services (enterprise network services), Lingyun Services (cloud and security services), and Digital Engineering projects (customized digital transformation solutions). The company employs a direct sales model and subscription fees for managed security and cloud services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: NOVA is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the SD-WAN and SASE markets, recognized as a market leader by IDC and other industry analysts. It competes with other network and cloud security providers in China, leveraging its proprietary backbone network and integrated cloud-network-security solutions. The company differentiates itself through its self-developed technologies, comprehensive global network, and strong partnerships with major telecom operators and cloud vendors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, NOVA reported revenues of approximately RMB 601 million, nearly stable compared to the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 18.3 million, reflecting a decline due to market and competitive pressures. The company’s gross margin decreased slightly to 29.81%. It maintains total assets close to RMB 947 million and equity around RMB 819 million. The company invests about 9.3% of revenue in R&D and is focused on sustainable growth through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NOVA emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing integrated 'cloud + network + security' digital solutions with high reliability, security, and flexibility. Its self-owned MPLS backbone network and proprietary SD-WAN/SASE technologies offer superior network stability and security. The company’s AI-enabled security services and global network coverage enable customers to achieve secure, agile, and intelligent digital transformation. Its deep collaboration with telecom operators and cloud providers creates differentiated, scalable, and customizable solutions tailored to enterprise needs.
